description: Defect correction: reproduce the failure first, fix it within a bounded scope, then review and verify the fix.

stages.purpose: Reproduce the reported defect with an executed check and record the failing evidence
Minimal fix for the reproduced defect with focused checks inside allowedFiles
Independent review of the fix diff for correctness and unintended side effects
Re-run the reproduction and regression checks against the fixed candidate

purposeOverrides.implement: Minimal fix for the defect; BEFORE changing anything record executed baseline evidence (the failing check output, or the exact quoted defect with file and line); focused checks inside allowedFiles
